method: Unmodified main build_poke_scene and Example._Forward; explicit endpoint targets; 1050 steps at dt=1/900 s; no experimental solver, overrides, factor cache, injectivity guard or QP changes.
scope: 35-frame forward validation on the prepared recording geometry, which differs from the original generated slab and 24-section TetGen probe. Not a new fitted checkpoint or a claim that the original penalty law prevents interpenetration.
measurement: 45 barycentric samples per probe triangle queried against oriented tetrahedral boundary and embedded display surface; die boundary vertices queried against probe. These sampled distances do not prove global nonintersection. Inversions, deformation and tracking are measured each recorded frame; iterations, status and contact pairs every substep.
timing_scope: Includes per-step host synchronization, signed-distance diagnostics and output writes; not a throughput benchmark. Concurrent user GPU work may affect timing.
source_change_scope: This report exercises forward only; adjoint.py is not called.
